own_broker.venue: IBKR own account, British Columbia resident (Interactive Brokers Canada Inc.)
own_broker.fee_rule_file: all_in_usd_per_side = IBKR execution (USD 0.85, the <=1,000 contracts/month band, equal for Tiered and Fixed) + clearing (USD 0.00 per the worked examples) + exchange fee (non-member / Tier I, exchange page of the product) + regulatory fee (exchange page). Plain sum; no overnight fee, no GST/PST, no market data.

rulings.LR-F5-IBKR: c_f = c_RT + F_rt / v, F_rt = 2 x all-in fee per side; G(h) <= 1.10 min G only (LR-F5-IBKR: own account, no DLL, MLL or flat-by-close condition); intraday holds end by the main session's end; overnight rows report the overnight margin
rulings.LR-Q6d: per code: initial margin (intraday, overnight) vs the capital ceiling; sigma_day = sigma_cc x v vs 2% of the ceiling; sigma_OC x v beside (inputs only)
